1937, March
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 178 Cont.
Mar. 30 Joseph Mercier - 78 - away from confession 4 yrs. Mary Debuschere - 18 - nose-bleed 4 days Martin Parte11 - 31 - strept-throat The Cowl - 10¢ Stella Englert - 44 - fearful pains in back & kidnies.
Page 179 Mar. 31st Miss Eliz. Magee - religious from Cleveland .... Arthritis ... Mrs. Bigger - 54 - stomach .. .
April
1937, April
Ist Michell Skorupski- 57 - stroke 6 months ago - lost speech ....
3rd Myron Bloomfield - 41 - facial neuralgia - can not eat. ... only liquids - eye completely closed - has wife and two boys .... now 2 months.
Albert A. McCarty - (45) Manager for big concern - still. . . Miller Family, Warren, Mich. 3 scres to sell - between Warren & Centerline - 11 to 18 Mi. Road.
Mrs. Minote Vareke - 65 - lost eye two yrs. ago - fears now that the trouble is coming back as cancer ..
Margaret Tobin 61 - double cataracts - May 5th reports O.K. no operation -"looks ten yrs. younger"
Lawrence Cantwell - T.B. feared in St. Mary's Hospt'l 6 weeks.
Page 180 Apr. 7 Sheila Demery - 21 mo. of Miami Fl. just now mastoid operation - now strept condit ... phoned this a.m. fr .. long distance. Drs. have very little hope .. ...
Mary DeBuysscher - 18 - had nose-bleed
35 Hemoraging from throat
Wm. V. Szpryma - 32 - in Eloise - at times seems better.
